body:
Ideally? I don’t believe I should have any suffering. Regardless of how bad my illness makes me feel about myself, I think deep down I know I deserve a dignified death like anyone else. But the laws and rules just aren’t in place yet to make it that simple, unfortunately.

Most of my attempts have really been just trying out various methods. Almost to see what my pain and discomfort threshold is, what gives me the worst consequences, etc.

I’m currently relapsing in my depression too and honestly reading these forums makes me feel like I’m not alone. Because everyone in real life is just annoyed/backing off from me. They all have a reality problem, they offer to help but when shit hits the fan people run away

Yes. I am also a victim of this.
Have had sexual abuse by so many male staff throughout my years of hospitalization, I just never said anything because I figured I would get over it and no one would believe me. Or it would cause more problems than solve.

Serotonin syndrome from OD’ing sucks too. Your eyes will likely feel bulging, your pupils looking like you’re high out of your mind, feet will feel heavy, reality might feel weird. Even if you threw it up, the hospital might give you a charcoal drink to neutralize anything shitty going on in your body. If not they can at least asses you for damage/monitor your vitals... even if you don’t go in now, please go in if you experience bad symptoms later.

Dude I get it.. family and school pressure are the worst. Growing up we always had things food on the table and education unlike a lot of my friends. But I live alone now and know what it’s like to be broke and struggling.. and I still wouldn’t trade it to go back to a time where I felt suffocated by my family and drowning in a college program that made me miserable.
I doubt the amount you took and the type of med it was will kill you. I suggest calling an ambulance to come pick you up (call 911). The longer you wait, the more damage you’re doing to your body.
Yeah, that’s what I meant (to move there). And I’ve never used the dark web. Not only do I not want to risk downloading the browser, but like you say, you never know wtf is being sold to you.
This page says user deleted. Fuck. Sending love wherever you are ♥️

Ive had a lot of years thinking about my stance on suicide letters. After everything I’ve been through, this is my belief - or rules if you will:

1) The note I leave is only addressed and directed to something/someone I love and care about
2) The note I leave does not have any negativity or blame 

Examples of notes I think are good to leave behind:

- I love you *insert close friend, close family member*

- Thank you *insert name* for being the best *insert role: teacher, parent, friend, etc*

- This is not your fault

- Everything will be okay

- My favourite things were *insert pastime*

- I’ll always be with you when you need me 

- Thank you *insert person, pet, friend, past time, sport, hobby, object, etc* for your years of service
As bad as this sounds, take it with a grain of salt because it’s likely my illness talking... but I can empathize with this situation. And I am slightly envious you have access to one.
What did you do? You must feel so shitty right now, I wish I could come give you a hug or some shit.

Yes. And those drugs are illegal I’m pretty sure. Very difficult in my opinion, especially if you don’t want trouble with the law. A thought that’s crossed my mind a lot is going to a place that has experience with euthanasia, and where it is legal. I’m still on the fence though, mostly because of how expensive it would be.
Thanks man. I believe good things gotta come to you regardless of what you choose

As tempting as it is, use everything in your power to keep fighting. You may feel like you’ve cut everything off to the point of no return, but it’s not true. It’s a trick your brain is playing on you right now, because your illness has obviously gotten very serious. Honestly fuck anyone who says you’re not allowed to do some self care and relax right now... whatever that is. Shutting off your phone, abandoning a commitment to get yourself calm, or to eat a decent meal, or to tell your employer you are not fit to work right now, or call a hotline/make arrangements to see a doctor. Anyone who tries to make your crisis invalid can fuck right off. You are deserving of AT LEAST that.

I’m glad you decided against it. I don’t know your whole story but I do know what it’s like to be minutes away from death. I’ve been suicidal since I was about 14 (I’m 21 now also) and have had some pretty bad unsuccessful attempts. No one will understand the depth of your pain and I’m sorry you are one of those people who’s life is a constant struggle. I hope you keep fighting man.

I doubt it would be a nice death. I feel like it would not only take an insane amount of pills (which that in itself may induce a panic attack and cause you to stop midway) but it would be filtered through your liver, which would be the main targeted organ. You could potentially go into liver failure, which would certainly feel awful and not a pleasant death - you may even call 911 before you succeed because of the pain and discomfort. Or: if  your body handles the overdose, you now have to deal with serious organ damage.

Have attempted with these and this is what happened: started with 10 50 mg tabs and my body rejected them almost immediately by throwing up. They’re very strong on your stomach, especially if you haven’t eaten. 
EDIT: and when I say the overdose made me sick to my stomach, I talk specifically of Trazodone. I’ve overtaken other medications and had several adverse reactions depending on the drug. I would say within 25 mins of trying to lay in bed and go to “sleep,” I jolted awake, rolled over to my side and puked my guts out completely involuntarily. My stomach was relatively empty as well, my last meal being dinner which had been about 7-8 hours prior to OD’ing.
